description: 402 payment challenge for ISS pass predictions — $0.05 USDC on Base via x402. Give lat (-90 to 90) and lon (-180 to 180); returns the live payment requirements plus how-to-pay steps for that exact request. The rail computes the next visible station passes from public CelesTrak orbital data and returns them automatically after settlement. This tool never pays and never touches private keys — pay from your own wallet. Example: {lat:30.5651, lon:-97.8441} returns the $0.05 challenge for Leander, Texas.
name: qm_data_iss_pass
